checklist.label: Confirm Valor dates, ride option and final quote
Confirm 7 November Hanoi pickup and pre-tour arrival
Confirm room type and private upgrade
Confirm meals, tickets and bus inclusions in writing
Clarify conflicting cancellation/deposit wording before payment
Ask for VAT and payment fees in the total
Confirm motorcycle-pillion cover and medical evacuation
Check helmet fit, chin strap and protective gear
Pack passport and offline document copies
Pack fleece, long trousers and a rain layer
Pack closed shoes with grip for walks
Carry small cash, phone/SIM and power bank
Pack sunscreen, sunglasses and insect repellent
Pack swimwear and a dry bag
Use a small riding bag; ask about large-bag storage
Confirm optional boat price and time before committing
Do not schedule a Sunday market for Monday 9 November
Confirm 11 November return bus and Hanoi accommodation

do: Choose a licensed local driver and check your cover.
Stop in daylight; let the guide change plans for weather.
Wear a fitted helmet, closed shoes and warm layers.
Ask before taking portraits; pay fairly for local crafts.
Keep offline maps, cash and a charged phone.
dont: Do not self-ride until Valor confirms your motorcycle licence, recognised international permit and insurance are valid in Vietnam.
Do not drink before riding or distract your driver.
Do not stop on blind bends or cross border restrictions.
Do not give children sweets or money for photographs.
Do not assume a river boat, upgrade or transfer is included.
